faqs.q: Sec. 54-161. - Violations are civil in nature.
faqs.a:
(a)
Notwithstanding any other provision of this Code, any parking citation issued pursuant
               to this division that involves signage that limits, regulates, restricts, or prohibits
               the parking, standing, or stopping of any vehicle shall be a civil parking violation,
               and not criminal in nature.
(b)
Notwithstanding any other provision of this Code, any parking citation issued pursuant
               to this division that involves signage that limits, regulates, restricts, or prohibits
               the parking, standing, or stopping of any vehicle shall contain a statement describing
               the process for disputing the parking citation.
(
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
